title: [main] bug 649305 - Add Report Address Source functionality to Company Information
summary: Company Information in the CZ localization now includes a configurable Report Address Source setting that lets users choose whether printed sales and purchase documents show the address from Company Information or a Responsibility Center.
key_points: New Report Address Source CZL enum with Company Information and Responsibility Center options
New field added to Company Information table 79 for CZ
Page 1 updated with the new field in Communication FastTab as an Additional field
Report address formatting logic updated to respect the configuration
Default value set to Responsibility Center for backward compatibility
quote: Adds a new Report Address Source option to the Company Information table and page for the CZ Core Localization Pack.
